statement: You are given an array height of non-negative integers. It describes an elevation map: bar i has width 1 and height height[i], and the bars stand side by side.

After rain, water collects above each bar up to the lower of the tallest bar to its left and the tallest bar to its right. Water above bar i therefore has depth min(maxLeft, maxRight) − height[i] when that is positive, and 0 otherwise.
Return the total amount of water trapped, in units.

examples.explanation: Water fills 1 unit at index 2, 1 at index 4, 2 at index 5, 1 at index 6 and 1 at index 9, for 6 in total.
The walls 4 and 5 hold water up to height 4 over the middle bars: 2 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 9 units.
